messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered for Service `cache-replica-read` (PD#PD-9821) — Severity: P3. Trigger: high 5xx rate on /embeddings endpoint.

pagerduty-bot: Alert details: https://pagerduty.example/PD-9821 · Escalation policy: infra-oncall · First notify: infra-schedule (rotation: owen -> lina).

maya.k: seeing a bunch of pages landing in my phone, is someone already on it?

owen: acked on PD so I'm looking. quick check — prod traffic dashboards not showing increased user errors, just spikes in internal retry logs.

lina: paging noise on my end too. PD shows service `cache-replica-read` but our service that normally owns that is `redis-serving`. suspect binding mismatch.

arjun: fwiw I ran `kubectl get svc -n infra cache-replica-read -o yaml` — it's a legacy service name that was used for a canary last month.

owen: hmm that matches. PD service recently created by onboarding script? @oncall-sre can you check PD service->schedule link?

oncall-sre: checking. `pd service get PD-9821` -> service shows escalation_policy: infra-oncall, but linked schedule is `infra-shadow-schedule` (ID: S-314) not `infra-schedule`. looks like a stray binding.

maya.k: so pages going to infra-oncall but via the wrong schedule alias — that's why some people got spammed out of band. Any customer impact?

arjun: quick customer check: SLO errors no, user-facing errors 200. Only internal retry errors in a batch worker that emits 5xx for healthy upstreams while draining caches. Affected region: us-west-2. Possibly a deploy that toggled the metric.

lina: can we suppress noise until we fix the binding? I can add a temporary suppression rule in PD for PD-9821 for 30m.

nowen: please do. suppressing now -> created maintenance window PD-MW-563 for PD-9821 (30m).

pagerduty-bot: Maintenance window created by lina. Pages silenced for PD-9821 until +00:30.

maya.k: thanks. next steps: 1) rebind PD service to correct schedule, 2) patch onboarding script to avoid creating stray services, 3) postmortem.

arjun: on the root cause side, logs show a cron job `canary-init` created service `cache-replica-read` two weeks ago and didn't clean up. It also registered that service in PD via API. I'll roll a quick script to unlink the PD service from the shadow schedule and relink to infra-schedule.

owen: do the relink but let's do it carefully. If we relink while escalation policy differs we might drop pages. Plan: 1) create a temp PD escalation test to confirm infra-schedule receives test notification, 2) relink, 3) cancel test.

arjun: running PD API: `curl -X PATCH https://api.pagerduty.example/services/PD-9821 -d '{"escalation_policy": "EP-INFRA-1"}'` -> 200 OK.

lina: did you verify infra-schedule got a test?

arjun: sent test event: PD test alert PD-TEST-1977. owen, did you get it?

nowen: got the test, confirmed. relink looks healthy. removing maintenance window in 2m and monitoring.

pagerduty-bot: Maintenance window PD-MW-563 ended.

maya.k: rolling out suppress -> rebind -> monitor went smooth. any further noisy pages?

lina: one duplicate page forwarded earlier to contractors (why?) — looks like an old PD service has responders list that includes a shared contractors escalation. I'll remove contractors from that service.

arjun: command: `pd service remove_key PD-9821 responders contractors-group` -> success.

nowen: checklist for post-incident: - disable cron that auto-registers PD services without cleanup - add unit test to onboarding script - run a one-off audit to list services with schedules not matching expected naming convention - postmortem + timeline and customer impact note.

maya.k: customer impact summary for SLT: no customer-facing errors, no SLO breaches, internal retries caused noisy high-sev pages to oncall. Some contractors got pages briefly. Estimated user impact: none. Action items: follow checklist.

lina: also setting an alert with a lower sensitivity for that metric so one noisy worker doesn't page infra. Change: increase threshold by 3x and add anomaly filter for short spikes.

arjun: committed onboarding script fix in `infra/scripts/onboard-pd` -> PR #1287.

nowen: handing over to lina for next shift. lina — you taking monitoring?

lina: taking handoff. I'll watch for 30m and then create follow-up ticket for postmortem owners.

maya.k: thanks everyone. I'll author the postmortem skeleton and assign to arjun/owen/lina.

pagerduty-bot: PD incident PD-9821 resolved (manual). Closed at ts: 1977777988.

incident-bot: Incident thread auto-archived.

owen: quick note for follow-up: run `pd schedule audit --team infra --output csv` and attach to postmortem.

lina: noted. I'll attach schedule audit and the PD API call logs to the postmortem.

maya.k: closing thread, moving action items to board. :white_check_mark:
